merged: **Mont Ventoux Observatory – Handover Summary (≤150 words)** - Telescopes: 60‑cm reflector (installed 2017) and 20‑cm outreach refractor. - Weather: ≈195 useful nights / yr (168 in 2024). - Data flow: ≈400 GB per night (≈400 GB / month) transferred to Marseille in ~40 min; exact nightly/monthly split is uncertain. - Camera: Main camera replaced March 2025, read‑noise ↓30 %; requires a full‑night offline firmware update. - Past incidents: 2023 dome‑motor seizure bent the counterweight rod (repaired, limit switch added); Feb 2025 a 1.2 s timestamp offset destroyed three weeks of photometry – now GPS‑checked each session. - Rules: No observing on outreach evenings; raw frames are compressed (policy varies – some notes say never delete, others after two years) – compression after two years is recorded, but the “never delete” clause remains uncertain; acquisition‑software changes need a test night. - Collaboration: Spanish group awaiting review/evaluation of a shared scheduling
